artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G - Security and Activation Boundary Audit

boundary_checks.evidence: Inspected agent.py, v30_candidate_d2_cash_cushion.py, and simulation engines: zero references to FIX protocol, Interactive Brokers TWS/Gateway, Alpaca, Schwab/TD Ameritrade, or Tradier APIs. No network socket connections or order-routing endpoints exist.
Dry-run execution uses exclusively local, in-memory synthetic Python dictionaries. Zero external HTTP requests, websockets, or REST API queries are invoked during dry-run execution.
Audited all read operations: zero file open calls, glob operations, or path traversals target market data dated on or after 2022-01-01. Tier 3 remains 100% untouched.
Verified exact SHA-256 baselines of agent.py (46e6...3ffd), v12_candidate_ae.py (978e...7793), and universe.json (6656...5bdd). File write permissions are strictly controlled.
All Stage 2G evidence files are authored to distinct paths with unique prefixes. Zero historical reports, manifests, or test logs have been modified, overwritten, or moved.

No cron jobs, background task schedulers, Windows Task Scheduler entries, or daemon processes are configured. The system cannot initiate autonomous evaluation without explicit human operator initiation.
Repository is confined to local disk; zero remote git push, package publication, or web service deployment has occurred or is possible.
